【温馨提示：所有涉及到有面板属性的章节都会加字哟~小扑街（划掉）小作者绝不水字数哒。】
普通人首次开启御兽蛋，并不像兽师开蛋一样，几乎是瞬间孵化完成。
而是会根据御兽蛋的品级，而有一段不小的孵化时间。
品级越高，孵化时间越长。
红光在狭小的房间中宛如呼吸般闪烁。
陈小草此时的心里已经再也没有其他念头，只剩下眼前的御兽蛋。
这也是一种玄之又玄的规则。
她需要在御兽蛋开启之前，依托观看到的御兽蛋中御兽的气息，来构建御兽空间基础。
等到御兽蛋孵化后，才能成功开辟御兽空间。
这是一个不可逆的过程。
陈小草自己也不知道这蛋孵化了多久。
等她醒过来的时候，刚好看到御兽蛋上裂开细细密密的裂痕。
下一秒，整个御兽蛋壳碎裂成尘埃，一只如同小狗般大小的浑身漆黑如墨的狐狸，正漂浮在她眼前的空中，将头埋在蓬松的尾巴里，睡的正酣。
碎裂的蛋壳惊醒了墨玉狐。
它抬起头来，一双如绿宝石的狐狸眼刚好撞上了陈小草红光未消的双眸。
“哈~”
墨玉狐弹身而起，冲着陈小草发出警告的嘶吼。
可紧接着，陈小草眸中红光退散，一道苍凉如亘古永存的视线从她眼中射出。
【第一步完成，专心开辟御兽空间。】

系统声音响起的同时，张牙舞爪的墨玉狐像是看到了什么至亲之人一样，肚皮朝上，咧着嘴巴哈着气。
陈小草来不及感叹这狐狸变脸之快，连忙收拢心神，开辟御兽空间。
基础早已搭建好，空间开辟的无比顺利。
几分钟后，御兽空间成型，空间门户大开。
而她也终于感受到了眼前墨玉狐与自己心灵之间那种玄妙的联系感觉。
将墨玉狐收进空间内，陈小草继续内视御兽空间。
这是开辟个人属性面板和御兽面板的关键步骤。

[Warm reminder: All chapters involving panel attributes will have added words~Xiao Pu Jie (crossed out), the author will never miss the number of words. 】
When an ordinary person opens a beast-taming egg for the first time, it is not like a beast master opening an egg. It hatches almost instantly.
Instead, there will be a long incubation time depending on the grade of the beast egg.
The higher the grade, the longer the incubation time.
The red light flickered like breathing in the small room.
Chen Xiaocao had no other thoughts at this time, only the beast egg in front of him.
This is also a mysterious and mysterious rule.
She needs to build the foundation of the beast-taming space based on the aura of the beast-taming egg she sees before opening the beast-taming egg.
Only after the beast-taming egg hatches can the beast-taming space be successfully opened.
This is an irreversible process.
Chen Xiaocao himself didn't know how long it took for the egg to hatch.
When she woke up, she happened to see the thin cracks on the beast egg.
The next second, the entire eggshell of the beast shattered into dust, and a fox as big as a puppy, covered in jet black ink, was floating in the air in front of her, with its head buried in its fluffy tail, sleeping soundly.
The broken eggshell woke up the black jade fox.
It raised its head, and a pair of emerald fox eyes just hit Chen Xiaocao's red eyes.
"Ha~"
The black jade fox jumped up and roared a warning at Chen Xiaocao.
But then, the red light in Chen Xiaocao's eyes dissipated, and a desolate sight that seemed to last forever shot out of her eyes.
[The first step is completed, concentrate on opening up the space for beast control. 】
At the same time as the sound of the system sounded, Mo Yuhu, who was baring his teeth and claws, seemed to have seen someone close to him, with his belly facing up, grinning and breathing.
Chen Xiaocao didn't have time to sigh at how quickly the fox changed his face, so he quickly gathered his mind and opened up a space to control the beast.
The foundation has already been laid, and the space development has been extremely smooth.
A few minutes later, the beast-controlling space took shape, and the space portal opened wide.
And she finally felt the mysterious connection between the Mo Yuhu in front of her and her own soul.
Putting the black jade fox into the space, Chen Xiaocao continued to look inside the beast-controlling space.
This is a key step in opening the personal attribute panel and beast control panel.
